product_metadata.title: Intelligent Design ID40-311 Teal Darkening Bedroom, Libra Print Chevron Grommet Living Room, Polyester Modern Window Curtains, 42X63, 2-Panel Pack
features: The Intelligent Design Libra Chevron Window Curtain Pair adds a dramatic and modern pop to your room. The herringbone design pairs perfectly with the bold chevron print, creating an edgy and fresh look. The chevron pattern is printed on polyester microfiber for easy care, while the foam back finish provides a darkening effect for energy efficiency. A silver grommet top detail makes it easier to hang, open, and close these window panels throughout the day. Fits up a to 1.25" diameter rod.
Material Details:100% Polyester microfiber 75gsm printing with 1 pass foam backing, Grommet Top
